_comment: Rust 侧错误文案的人工英文翻译。键必须与 Rust 源码里的中文字面量完全一致（含占位符）。未登记的条目在英文模式下会原样显示中文 —— 新增错误时必须在这里补一行。
SteamGridDB API Key 无效或无权限: SteamGridDB API key is invalid or unauthorized
SteamGridDB 游戏条目缺少 id: SteamGridDB game entry is missing an id
下载不完整：应收到 {declared} 字节，实际只收到 {done} 字节，: Incomplete download: expected {declared} bytes, received {done} bytes. Please retry.
下载候选图标失败: HTTP {}: Failed to download candidate artwork: HTTP {}
下载内容无法识别（既不是修改器也不是压缩包），可能被杀软截留: Downloaded content was not recognized as a trainer or archive — it may have been blocked by antivirus
下载被拒绝（{}）。站点可能开启风控，稍后再试: Download rejected ({}). The site may be rate-limiting; try again later
主程序不存在：{rel}（可能被杀软删除）: Main executable is missing: {rel} (possibly removed by antivirus)
修改器根目录不存在: Trainer root folder does not exist
候选图无法解码: Candidate artwork could not be decoded
删除失败：{e}（修改器可能正在运行，请先退出）: Delete failed: {e} (the trainer may be running — close it first)
压缩包内 manifest 缺少 title: The archive's manifest is missing a title
同名包目录已存在：{}（如需重装请先删除）: A folder with the same name already exists: {} (delete it first to reinstall)
启动失败（Win32 错误码 {err}）。若为需要管理员权限的修改器，请在 U: Launch failed (Win32 error {err}). If the trainer needs administrator rights, confirm the UAC prompt
备份内路径不存在: {}: Path inside the backup does not exist: {}
备份包缺少清单: The backup archive is missing its manifest
打开下载文件失败: {e}: Failed to open the downloaded file: {e}
无法定位应用数据目录: {e}: Could not locate the app data folder: {e}
无法定位父目录: Could not locate the parent folder
未启用云存档，请先在「设置 → 扩展」里打开: Cloud saves are disabled — enable them in Settings → Extensions
本地存档较新，已跳过（请单独恢复并确认）: Local saves are newer, skipped (restore individually to confirm)
游戏未安装，无法恢复（{{p|game}}）: Game is not installed, cannot restore ({{p|game}})
目录里找不到修改器：{trainer_id}: Trainer not found in the folder: {trainer_id}
目录里找不到该下载地址（请刷新搜索）: That download URL was not found in the catalog (try refreshing)
目标缺少文件名: Target is missing a file name
目标缺少父目录: Target is missing a parent folder
认证失败：用户名或密码不正确（401）: Authentication failed: wrong username or password (401)
该修改器正在下载，请先取消或等待完成: This trainer is downloading — cancel it or wait for it to finish
该包没有可执行主程序，请打开目录手动选择: This package has no main executable — open the folder and pick one manually
该来源只提供官网/网盘下载页，请使用「官网获取」手动下载: This source only provides an official/netdisk page — use “Official site” to download manually
该目录不是已安装的修改器包（缺少 manifest.json）: This folder is not an installed trainer package (missing manifest.json)
请先在 设置 → 游戏图标 中配置 SteamGridDB API Key: Configure a SteamGridDB API key in Settings → Game artwork first
读取游戏列表失败: Failed to read the game list
路径不存在（404）：请检查地址是否为 WebDAV 根目录: Path not found (404): check that the address is the WebDAV root
路径缺少文件名: Path is missing a file name
